# CML

> > CML (Continuous Machine Learning) brings DevOps best practices to machine learning with automated, reproducible workflows across GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.

CML is an open-source platform that enables ML teams to automate model training, evaluation, and reporting through CI/CD pipelines. It integrates seamlessly with popular version control and CI/CD systems to streamline machine learning workflows.

## Key Topics

- Continuous Machine Learning
- GitHub Actions
- CI/CD Integration
- Machine Learning Workflow
- DVC Integration
- Model Reporting
- Metrics Tracking
- GitLab CI
- Bitbucket Pipelines
- Automated Testing
- Version Control
- Docker
- Workflow Automation
- Getting Started
- Asset Publishing

- [Home | CML](https://cml.dev/doc): CML documentation home with getting started and core concepts

## Usage & Workflows

- [Usage | CML](https://cml.dev/doc/usage): CML usage guide for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket workflows
